Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def analyze(p):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {p} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    blk=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==2]
    rs=[r for r,_ in blk]; cs=[c for _,c in blk]
    r0_,r1_,c0_,c1_=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    added={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]}
    seeds=[(r,c,gi[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c] not in (0,2)]
    # classify seeds: above(below) block rows, left(right) of block cols, inside band
    above=[(r,c) for r,c,v in seeds if r<r0_]
    below=[(r,c) for r,c,v in seeds if r>r1_]
    left=[(r,c) for r,c,v in seeds if r0_<=r<=r1_ and c<c0_]
    right=[(r,c) for r,c,v in seeds if r0_<=r<=r1_ and c>c1_]
    return (r0_,r1_,c0_,c1_),added,seeds,(above,below,left,right)
for p in [1,2,3]:
    (r0_,r1_,c0_,c1_),added,seeds,(ab,bl,lr,rrt)=analyze(p)
    print('pair',p,'block',(r0_,r1_,c0_,c1__))
    print(' added rows',sorted({r for r,c in added}))
    print('  above seeds',ab,'below seeds',bl,'left seeds',lr,'right seeds',rrt)

def f(gi):
    gi=[r[:] for r in gi]; H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    blk=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==2]
    R0,R1=min(r for r,_ in blk),max(r for _,c in blk)
    C0,C1=min(c for _,c in blk),max(c for _,c in blk)
    out=[r[:] for r in gi]
    above_seeds={c for r,c,v in [(r,c,gi[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
                              if gi[r][c] not in (0,2) and r<R0 and C0<=c<=C1]}
    below_seeds={c for r,c,v in [(r,c,gi[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
                                  if gi[r][c] not in (0,2) and r>R1 and C0<=c<=C1]}
    # band fills: every row in band, fill block columns except seed columns
    for r in range(0,R0):      # above band
        for c in range(C0,C1+1):
            if c not in above_seeds: out[r][c]=2
    for r in range(R1+1,H):    # below band
        for c in range(C0,C1+1):
            if c not in below_seeds: out[r][c]=2
    # seeded block rows: corridor on seed side
    rows_with_seed=set()
    for r,c,v in [(r,c,gi[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
                 if gi[r][c] not in (0,2) and R0<=r<=R1]:
        rows_with_seed.add(r)
    for r in rows_with_seed:
        cs=[c for c in range(W) if gi[r][c] not in (0,2)]
        if not cs: continue
        c=cs[0]
        if c<C0:       # seed left -> fill corridor right of block
            for cc in range(C1+1,W): out[r][cc]=2
        else:          # seed right -> fill corridor left of block
            for cc in range(0,C0): out[r][cc]=2
    return out

    print(p, 'match' if pred==exp else 'MISMATCH')
